add.event: 英国将英镑从1英镑兑2.80美元贬值至2.40美元
add.evidence: The UK government devalued the pound sterling in November 1967 from £1 = $2.80 to £1 = $2.40.

add.event: 巴塞尔协议旨在减少英镑向美元的外逃
add.evidence: The Basel agreements of 1968 were designed to minimise flight from sterling to the US dollar.

add.event: 英国对英镑区其他成员实施外汇管制（爱尔兰与皇家属地除外）
add.evidence: On 22 June 1972, Britain imposed exchange controls between Britain and other members of the sterling area

add.event: 英国取消全部外汇管制，英镑区实际上不复存在
add.evidence: In 1979, due to an improving economic situation and changed patterns of trade between Britain and the rest of the Commonwealth, Britain removed all its exchange controls: the sterling area had effectively ceased to exist.
